title: "Starting point or expectations are unclear"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Find the missing expectation

Write the next expected outcome and who expects it. Separate formal requirements, supervisor preferences, disciplinary conventions and your assumptions.

## Try this now

1. Check the current candidature milestone or written task.
2. Find one accepted example and identify what it demonstrates—not what to copy.
3. List the decisions, evidence and acceptance criteria you can infer.
4. Ask the responsible person to confirm the missing criterion.
5. Record the agreed outcome, owner, date and evidence of done.

## What to take when asking

Bring: “I understand the outcome to be [state]. I found [requirement/example]. I am uncertain about [one decision]. My proposed next deliverable is [artefact] by [date]. Is that the right standard?”

## Route

- Expectations differ between supervisors: use the [supervisor expectations guide](../templates/supervisor-expectations.qmd).
- The task is too large: convert it into a milestone and next action.
- No one can identify the authority: ask the graduate research coordinator or responsible office.

## Stop or escalate

Escalate repeated non-response, irreconcilable instructions, unsafe expectations or formal milestones threatened by missing direction.

## You are moving again when

The next deliverable, acceptance test, reviewer and date are written and accepted.
